column1: # Limits sites publish themselves: a robots.txt Crawl-delay or an API's stated rate. One row per host.
# per_hour: at most that many requests in any hour. burst, cooldown_s: at most burst requests in any
# cooldown_s seconds (a Crawl-delay of D is burst 1, cooldown_s D). fresh_profile: yes when the site wants a
# new browser profile for every query (the gate cannot do that for you: plan the run for it).
# Every row cites its source in notes. Only add a limit the site publishes; a limit you met is a hard-won note.

column6: JSON/YAML API: 20 requests per minute, 1 hour block when exceeded (checked 2026-11-02) https://www.loc.gov/apis/json-and-yaml/working-within-limits/
usage policy: an absolute maximum of 1 request per second (checked 2026-11-02) https://operations.osmfoundation.org/policies/nominatim/
